structured_output.what_is_happening: On 2026-09-22 Trump told the UN that US documents will call AI "super intelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence" (reported by Futurism, Axios, WaPo, Gizmodo and TechCrunch). At 23:26 UTC Alex Jones (@RealAlexJones) posted "The Lines Have Been Drawn: Trump Announces Super Intelligence AI VS. Super Retarded AI!" with a Mike Adams video. The post had weak reach when checked: about 29k views, 57 likes and 16 retweets. From about 23:29 UTC, at least 10 Solana tokens named "Super Retarded Inu" / SRI were launched, plus copies on Robinhood chain and ARC. This one (2z37…) was created at 23:38:56 UTC on the Meteora virtual curve and moved to PumpSwap straight away. It took the most volume, about $2.18M in its first hour, and peaked at about $769k market cap (ATH). At detection it was already falling: m5 price −33% to −43%, and only $83k of GeckoTerminal m5 volume against $1.48M in m30. It has no website, socials, DexScreener profile or boosts. An earlier SRI (GCUv…, 23:30 UTC) is the copy whose DexScreener profile links the Alex Jones tweet.

narrative.description: This is a joke built on a real news event. Trump rebranded AI as "super intelligence" at the UN, and Alex Jones turned that into "Super Intelligence AI vs Super Retarded AI". Adding "Inu" is the launchers' own twist; Jones's post does not mention a dog. The parent story (Trump's "super intelligence" rebrand) is real, current and heavily covered. This offensive spin-off rests on one low-engagement Alex Jones post.
narrative.why_spreading: Memecoin launchers race to tokenize any viral phrase tied to a Trump headline. The phrase is edgy and 'retard' memes have a history (e.g. RETARDIO), so it fits trench culture. But the source post had only about 29k views and 57 likes. Outside the tokens themselves I found no organic discussion on X, Reddit or Telegram through search, and no news article uses the phrase.

token_connection.why_this_token: It became the volume and liquidity leader among the SRI copies (about $438k market cap and $67k liquidity versus about $109k for the next ones), probably through launch mechanics and bot flow. It was not first, and nothing links it to the source: it has no socials, website or profile. The only link to the Alex Jones tweet sits on the GCUv… copy's DexScreener profile.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 Solana SRI tokens were launched between 23:29 and 23:59 UTC. GCUv… (23:30, Raydium SRI/NVDAx pair, links the AJ tweet, about $109–124k market cap, $470k h1 volume). oisncy… (about $109k market cap, $722k h1 volume). AoGR… (Meteora, $2.6M h1 volume but only $96 liquidity). B26a…pump and several dead $3k copies. There are also multiple SRI copies on the Robinhood chain (one about $334k market cap) and ARC.

authenticity.evidence: Organic elements: a real, fresh trigger (the Jones post after major Trump/UN news) and about 2,150 unique buyers in the first hour. Promotional and manipulated elements: GMGN tags 109 bundler wallets. GeckoTerminal counts 2,152 unique buyers but only 153 unique sellers, which suggests many tiny or bot buys. Five-minute unique buyers fell to about 125, so activity dropped from the m30 peak. Around 10 copycat launches within 30 minutes is the usual trench farming pattern. No organic social discussion was found. There are no paid DexScreener boosts and no KOL or smart-money wallets (smart 0, renowned 0).

Liquidity of about $67k against a $438k market cap; h1 turnover was 37x, which is extreme churn
Many same-name copies split attention across Solana, Robinhood chain and ARC
Creator status is 'creator_close' (dev exited); new wallet with one token launched

structured_output.counterargument: "Super intelligence" was one of the biggest culture-war tech stories of the day. Alex Jones has a large audience, and the phrase is crude, catchy and meme-friendly. 2z37… has already won the copycat race on volume, liquidity and holders (about 2,150), so late traders may treat it as the Solana SRI by default. The coin already did about 7x in its first hour, and a second leg is common if a larger account, or Trump-adjacent media, repeats "super retarded AI". There are no paid boosts, and GMGN's 7% top-10 figure suggests supply is not extremely concentrated.

Searches for the contract address, the $SRI ticker and the token name found nothing organic. News confirms Trump's UN 'super intelligence' rebrand. No outlet uses 'super retarded'. The token has no site or socials; DexScreener and GeckoTerminal show none.

structured_output.thesis: This is a short-lived copycat meme. It hangs off a single low-reach Alex Jones post riffing on Trump's real "super intelligence" UN rebrand. This contract is not the original or the linked SRI. It only won the bot and volume race among 10+ same-name launches. At detection it was already more than 40% off its ATH, with collapsing five-minute activity, 109 bundler wallets and no socials. Continuing would need a fresh amplifier that I could not find evidence of.
